'''Vyn Holpur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Saber]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of a [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in the Lost Tribe's [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|fleet]], the ''[[Starstalker]]''. He served under [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] as a part of the strike force sent to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to force [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to ally with them to eliminate [[Abeloth]], in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. Skywalker proposed that they utilize [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug|asteroid tug]] for assistance in navigating the Maw, and so the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] decided to wait for Calrissian at [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. Eventually, the allies left to wait for Calrissian just outside the Maw, leaving Captain Holpur and the ''Starstalker'' behind with [[Leeha Faal]] and the ''[[Winged Dagger]]''. Taalon gave an order for Faal which she relayed to Holpur, to acquire [[wintrium]] samples from the sacred [[Fountain of Ancients|Fountain of the Ancients]] on Klatooine. Holpur led his crew in their [[Violation|mission]], although they were met with resistance by [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] guards. They obtained the samples, but the ''Starstalker'' was attacked by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] who were called to protect the Fountain. The Sith were captured and brought to trial by Calrissian and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], who had just arrived in-[[Star system/Legends|system]]. Faal claimed that Holpur and his crew had acted of his own accord, and Holpur upheld her lie. Solo and Calrissian weren't fooled, but they had no proof that Faal was guilty, and so only were able to convict Holpur and the crew of the ''Starstalker''. Holpur and his crew were then sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]].
